lyrics.text:
Monggo sami nderek Gusti

Nderek Gusti ora rugi nyatane

Sak nyatane wae uripku pundak berkahi
Nderek Gusti ora rugi nyatane

Nderek Gusti soyo ayem atine
Mulane Gusti Yesus tak puji selawase

Monggo sami ndherek Gusti,
Gusti Yesus juru wilujeng,
